title.zh: 杭州银行市净率修复路径分析
title.en: Hangzhou Bank P/B Ratio Recovery Analysis

question.zh: 杭州银行的市净率能否在合理时间窗口内修复至1倍以上？
question.en: Can Hangzhou Bank's P/B ratio recover to above 1.0 within a reasonable time window?

hypothesis.zh: 杭州银行的PB将在2027年上半年突破1倍
hypothesis.en: Hangzhou Bank's P/B ratio will break above 1.0 by H1 2027

decision_deadline.zh: 2027年第一季度（2026年年报披露前后）

success_metric.zh: 杭州银行股价/每股净资产 >= 1.0
success_metric.en: Hangzhou Bank stock price / book value per share >= 1.0

domain.zh: 金融投资 / A股银行股

current_state.zh: 杭州银行（600926.SH）当前PB约0.85倍，ROE 14.65%，不良率0.76%，拨备覆盖率502%，核心一级资本充足率9.59%。A股42家上市银行全部处于破净状态（板块均值PB约0.54-0.65倍）。
current_state.en: Hangzhou Bank (600926.SH) currently trades at ~0.85x P/B with ROE of 14.65%, NPL ratio of 0.76%, provision coverage of 502%, and CET1 ratio of 9.59%. All 42 A-share listed banks trade below book value (sector average P/B ~0.54-0.65x).

source_summary.zh: A股42家上市银行全部处于破净状态，板块均值PB约0.54-0.65倍
source_summary.en: All 42 A-share listed banks trade below book value, with sector average P/B of 0.54-0.65x

source_summary.zh: 即使经营质量优异的银行也面临板块整体估值下压的系统性力量
source_summary.en: Even high-quality banks face systemic downward pressure from sector-wide valuation compression

source_quality.zh: 中 - 来自公开市场数据的参考类统计
source_quality.en: Medium - Reference-class statistics from public market data

summary.zh: 杭州银行14.65%的ROE在A股上市银行中排名前五。若戈登增长模型成立，理论合理PB约为1.93倍，当前0.85倍估值暗含市场对ROE将大幅下滑的预期，与经营趋势明显背离。
summary.en: Hangzhou Bank's 14.65% ROE ranks top 5 among A-share listed banks. Gordon growth model suggests fair P/B of ~1.93x. The current 0.85x implies market expects ROE to collapse, contradicting operating trends.

notes.zh: 国泰海通、东北证券预计2026-2028年净利润复合增速10-11%，ROE有望保持14-16%
notes.en: Guotai Haitan and Dongbei Securities expect 10-11% net profit CAGR for 2026-2028, ROE maintained at 14-16%

summary.zh: 不良率连续13个季度维持0.76%，拨备覆盖率长期高于500%，在A股银行中属第一梯队，存在大量隐藏价值可释放为利润。
summary.en: NPL ratio stable at 0.76% for 13 consecutive quarters, provision coverage above 500%, among the best in A-share banks. Excess provisions represent hidden value.

notes.zh: 个人经营贷不良率从0.93%升至1.52%，消费贷不良率从1.20%升至1.45%，需结构性关注
notes.en: Personal business loan NPL rose from 0.93% to 1.52%, consumer loan NPL from 1.20% to 1.45% — warrants monitoring

summary.zh: 2026Q1营收增速回升至4.29%，利息净收入同比大增20.69%，净息差从1.36%企稳回升至约1.39%。利息净收入占营收约75%。
summary.en: Q1 2026 revenue growth recovered to 4.29%, net interest income surged 20.69% YoY, NIM stabilized at ~1.39% from 1.36%.

notes.zh: 若这一趋势延续，2026年全年营收增速有望回升至8-10%
notes.en: If this trend continues, full-year 2026 revenue growth could recover to 8-10%

summary.zh: 核心一级资本充足率9.59%，低于A股上市城商行平均水平（约10.92%），是制约ROE维持高位的结构性约束。
summary.en: CET1 ratio of 9.59% is below the A-share city commercial bank average (~10.92%), constraining high ROE sustainability.

notes.zh: '杭银转债'全额转股（149.94亿元）已于2025年完成，缓解了短期资本压力
notes.en: Full conversion of 14.994B yuan in convertible bonds completed in 2025, easing short-term capital pressure

summary.zh: 分红率21.89-26.08%，长期低于30%监管线。中国人寿减持、澳洲联邦银行清仓反映部分股东不满。
summary.en: Dividend payout ratio of 21.89-26.08% remains below the 30% regulatory guidance. China Life and CBA reductions reflect shareholder dissatisfaction.

notes.zh: 已明确'原则上每年实施两次现金分红'，分红率呈上升趋势
notes.en: HZB has committed to semi-annual cash dividends; payout ratio is on an upward trend

summary.zh: 行长空缺11个月后于2026年3月补位完成，全员70后高管团队以内部培养为主，战略连贯性强。
summary.en: 11-month CEO vacancy filled in March 2026. All-post-70s senior team is predominantly home-grown with strong strategic continuity.

notes.zh: 人事变动本身不会直接驱动PB修复，但不确定性已解除
notes.en: Management changes alone don't drive P/B recovery, but the uncertainty has been resolved

summary.zh: 政府工作报告追加3000亿元特别国债补充银行资本，央行表态支持银行稳定净息差，逆周期让利阶段基本结束。
summary.en: Government adds 300B yuan special bonds for bank capital. PBOC signals NIM stabilization support. Counter-cyclical profit concessions largely ended.

notes.zh: 政策对国有大行倾斜更多，对城商行的利好传导链条更长
notes.en: Policies favor large state-owned banks; transmission to city commercial banks has a longer chain

summary.zh: 宁波银行PB约1.1倍、南京银行PB约1.05倍，杭州银行当前约15-30%折价。经营质量相近，估值差距构成均值回归压力。
summary.en: Ningbo Bank at ~1.1x P/B, Nanjing Bank at ~1.05x. Hangzhou Bank's 15-30% discount to similar-quality peers creates mean-reversion pressure.

notes.zh: 在基本面没有显著恶化的情况下，15%+的折价难以长期维持
notes.en: A 15%+ discount is unlikely to persist without significant fundamental deterioration

summary.zh: PB已从2023年的0.53倍修复至当前约0.85倍，涨幅约60%。市场已在逐步纠正此前的低估。当前仍低于历史均值约0.90倍。
summary.en: P/B recovered from 0.53x trough in 2023 to ~0.85x, a ~60% gain. Market is gradually correcting prior undervaluation. Still below historical average of ~0.90x.

name.zh: 等待2026年年报确认后买入
name.en: Wait for 2026 annual report before buying

name.zh: 减持/卖出杭州银行股票

candidates.zh: 跟踪2026年Q2-Q4净息差季度环比数据，确认息差企稳趋势
candidates.en: Monitor Q2-Q4 2026 NIM data quarter-over-quarter to confirm NIM stabilization trend

candidates.zh: 关注2026年中报营收增速是否回升至5%以上
candidates.en: Watch if H1 2026 revenue growth recovers to above 5%

candidates.zh: 观察2026年度分红率是否提升至30%以上
candidates.en: Observe if the 2026 dividend payout ratio increases to above 30%
